propositions: Batched overlap-judge calls without operation-local output, retry, and timeout bounds inherit generic 16,000-token/600-second policy, causing three sequential generations and multi-minute latency before safe abstention on malformed responses.

Token-output limit alone is insufficient to contain latency; schema validation acts only after malformed payload is fully generated; structured-retry count must be explicitly lowered to one and transport attempts to one.

RunRequest budget contract must be extended with lowering-only per-request seams for structured-retry, transport-attempt, and timeout, applied before model/provider construction in runner._effective_config.

Overlap-judge calls must declare explicit advisory budgets: 1,024 output tokens, one structured attempt, one transport attempt, and 60-second timeout; any bound hit continues through documented safe all-candidate abstention.
Valid batched verdict demultiplexing, label-keyed mapping, and aggregation behavior must be preserved; existing callers omitting request-local limits must retain prior defaults.
